summary: Read-only measurement of the live operator database (:5432, workspace papercusp-workspace and every other tenant, unscoped). The unique index on (workspace_id, feature_id) exists and migration 1444 is applied, so a cross-harness twin insert is refused (R-1). No (workspace_id, feature_id) pair has more than one row across 334839 work_items rows (R-3). Every one of the 15 rows that migrations 826 and 1443 renumbered is found once under its new id, records its old id, and that old id resolves to exactly one row (R-3). The insert-refusal behaviour itself is proven by packages/operator-core/lib/work-item-twin-merge.integration.test.ts, which this record does not replace.
